title: Setup: the standard array face up is not a dealt start
rationale: This is a position record of this game — every piece stands where the standard array puts it, and a record with nothing face down is spelled exactly as the Xiangqi position it is not — and it is not a position a game of this one begins in, because a game begins from a deal and every piece here is face up. The refusal is not-dealt-start, and it names neither a side nor a point: a deal is dealt whole, so a shape that is not one is not one at a square, and there is no composer here to be told what to fix next. It is the answer not-frozen-start could not give, this game holding a start for every deal rather than one.
